page.description: What we keep and why, without making you fight the fine print. If anything's unclear, write to us.
page.title: Privacy Policy

academic.body: Manualito is a final degree project (TFG) for research and demonstration purposes, not a commercial service.
academic.heading: Academic project

data.body: Your email, the name you choose, and the rulebook images you upload.
data.heading: What data do we process?

images.body: We process them to extract the text. If you turn on “delete photos after processing” in Settings, they're deleted when processing finishes. The extracted text is saved with your rulebook.
images.heading: Your rulebook images

processing.body: OCR and the language model run on the project's infrastructure. We don't share your data with third parties to train their models.
processing.heading: Where is it processed?

rights.body: You can view and delete your information from Settings (delete your account or sign out). If you need anything else, write to us.
rights.heading: Your rights

usage.body: To give you access to your account, process your photos (OCR), and generate explanations of the rulebook. We don't sell your data or use it for advertising.
usage.heading: What do we use it for?
